Immutable sealed helper/native leaf execveat, exact parent-thread/credential/FD/cancellation and durable possibly-executed evidence remain required. Separate callback-v5 approval was read and canonically verified; typed Git-only PreparedGitStep credentials and stricter sealed runtime must never substitute for vendor CommittedDispatch or leak into its FD set.

Bounded first design-approved component is BUG-1808 SealedExecImage + WaitingChild/channel/cancellation with NO production release, persistent assignment schema or live caller. Transport alone does not satisfy the production prerequisite. Common publication/assignment/receipt/callback integration first, TASK-1607 occupancy next, BUG-1802 policy later. Pane/containment positives, complete gateway/history integration, real-entrypoint witness matrices and independent implementation acceptance remain outstanding. No source/build/test/live experiment, status/queue/grant/hold change, cleanup or merge. Final authority-sensitive merge remains operator-owned. Review turn ended after this handoff.
subject: Launch v2 narrow independent signoffs; production gates retained
